steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 30; S.xp = 30000; S.level = FB.state.levelFromXp(30000); S.rods.push('star'); S.rod = 'star'; FB.hud.update(); return S.level;

steps.name: пруд: утка
steps.js: FB.panels.goTo('village'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('village', 'sun'); FB.places.reset(); const st = FB.places.state(); st.ducks.push({ tx: 0.15, dist: 0.35, goal: 0.4, v: 0.05, t: 1, state: 'swim' });

steps.name: горы: тени
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn') && document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); FB.panels.goTo('mountain'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('mountain', 'sun'); FB.places.reset(); FB.places.update(0.01); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); FB.places.update(9); return FB.places.state().shadows.length;

steps.name: болото: огонёк
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn') && document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); FB.S.tips.see_shadows = 1; FB.panels.goTo('swamp'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('swamp', 'night'); FB.places.reset(); FB.places.state().wisp = { tx: 0.35, dist: 0.4, t: 1, life: 30, ph: 0 };

steps.name: пристань: косяк
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn') && document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); FB.S.tips.see_wisp = 1; FB.panels.goTo('pier'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('pier', 'sun'); FB.places.reset(); FB.places.state().school = { tx: 0.35, dist: 0.45, t: 1, life: 60, left: 3 };

steps.name: лагуна: прилив
steps.js: document.querySelector('.coach .btn') && document.querySelector('.coach .btn').click(); FB.S.tips.see_school = 1; const PL = FB.places; const now = FB.sdk.now(); const ph = now % PL.TIDE_PERIOD; FB.sdk.mockShift = (PL.TIDE_PERIOD - ph) + 30000; FB.panels.goTo('lagoon'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('lagoon', 'sun'); return PL.chip();

FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.resize(); FB.panels.goTo('swamp'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('swamp', 'fog'); FB.places.reset(); FB.places.state().wisp = { tx: 0.3, dist: 0.35, t: 1, life: 30, ph: 0 };
